text:
elaine: Heads up — need to sync on a new marketplace renewal pattern we're piloting: a 12mo "staircase" commit (month-by-month ramp bands) + hardware partner credit routing + SI onboarding credits. Want to lock the ops checklist and pricing bands before we share with sales ops.
ramon: quick tl;dr of ask? are we changing contract terms or just marketplace private-offer presentation + sku? :thinking:
maria: want to see the P&L impact before we promise credits. can we model 3 scenarios (conservative/expected/upside) with uplift and churn sensitivity?
elaine: yes — goal is only marketplace private offers & private SKU packaging. Not changing core Redwood Dedicated contracts. Plan: offer customers a 12-month private offer with committed $ spend broken into bands: 40% Q1, 30% Q2, 20% Q3, 10% Q4 (staircase). hardware partners provide a one-time onboarding credit that applies to invoice months 1–3. SI partner credit is earned after first successful deployment milestone (apply as invoice credit month 4).
chris: FYI from HW side: partners will only allow credits if we commit to minimum ship volume and joint announcement. needs 30-day notice to legal. :warning:
ramon: from sales — staircase helpful for customers who ramp consumption. question: what discount levels by band? sales needs guardrails to avoid margin erosion on low-usage accounts.
elaine: suggested discount bands (marketplace private-offer): band A (>= committed % usage) -> 15% off list, band B (>= 70% usage) -> 10% off, band C (>= 50%) -> 5% off. Early churn clause: if customer uses < 40% of committed in first 6 months, prorated recoup.
maria: run the numbers. if avg realization is 60% we lose ~3.2% gross margin at current cost assumptions. need to cap HW credit passthrough to 50% of partner credit to avoid negative gross on initial invoices.
ops-bot: checklist created: 1) draft marketplace PO template, 2) compute three-scenario P&L, 3) legal review for hw co-sell clause, 4) SI milestone language, 5) billing rule: auto-apply partner credit months 1-3, 6) sales SKUs + playbook.
ramon: ok — sales ask: include example scripts and objection answers. can we get an example private-offer snippet for marketplace team to preview? e.g., what the PO terms look like.
elaine: attaching quick example (below) — use this as prototype in marketplace UI. ```
{
  "term_months": 12,
  "commit_amount": "$300,000",
  "staircase_split": "40/30/20/10",
  "discount_scheme": [{"band":">=100%","discount":"15%"},{"band":"70-99%","discount":"10%"},{"band":"50-69%","discount":"5%"}],
  "hw_credit": "$30,000 apply months 1-3",
  "si_credit": "$15,000 on milestone: deployment verification month 3"
}
```
chris: looks fine. will request partner legal signoff and confirm the $30k cap. also ask HW to commit to marketing asset for joint announcement if we hit $500k booked in 90 days.
maria: finance note — need GL code mapping for credit passthrough. suggest mapping partner credit to revenue contra (rev-credits) and SI credit as cost of partnership. I'll loop in accounting.
ramon: sales ops — can you build the SKU with three line items: commit, hw-credit (negative), si-credit (conditional)? also need renewal automation to surface true-up dialog in month 10.
elaine: good call. ops-bot — add action: sales ops to prototype SKU + renewal UI banner by EOW.
ops-bot: updated checklist: + sales-ops SKU prototype by 2026-04-08, + finance GL mapping by 2026-04-09, + partner legal by 2026-04-12.
maria: I'll run the three-scenario P&L and share in the partnerships drive. target review meeting Thurs 3pm PT.
ramon: i'll prep sales playbook snippets and objections doc.
elaine: thanks everyone. main risk: hw partner delays + legal timeline. if that slips we flatline the joint announcement but can still offer private-offer without co-sell badge. follow-ups: 1) maria P&L, 2) chris partner legal, 3) ramon sales playbook, 4) sales-ops SKU prototype. meet Thurs 3pm PT to finalize.
chris: noted. will ping partner success and legal.
elaine: :thumbsup: meeting invite incoming.
